description: The angles in use across every tracked brand in the trailing window: the same shape as sightglass_find_angles, with the brand on each. Filter by angle type, the age band or awareness stage of the persona it speaks to, or a categoryId (e.g. the user's brand's category), and sort by ads, landing pages or newest. Whatever the sort, angles carried by ads come first and ones seen only on landing pages last. Use it for 'what pitches are brands using on this audience' and to find an angle nobody is running. Fields the current plan does not include come back null and are named in that item's `locked` list (`estimates` = sales, visits and traffic). When a list is capped, `planLimit` is set: `maxResults` is the cap, `hiddenResults` is how many matching rows were not returned, and there is no next page. Do not estimate omitted values. Returns data only: nothing is shown to the user yet. Once you know the answer, call sightglass_show once with this call's resultId to show it as cards; the show call does not search again. For multi-step competitor research, read the replo skill (call skills with name "replo").

categoryId.description: Scope to one industry category's subtree, e.g. the user's brand's: a brand's `category.id` from sightglass_get_company, or an id from sightglass_get_rankings.

limit.description: Most results to return: 20 by default, up to 50. Ones carried by ads come first.

projectId.description: Replo project id, from list_projects: where the charge or the asset lands. Its workspace's plan applies.

workspaceId.description: Replo workspace id, from list_workspaces. Sets which workspace's plan applies; required when the user has more than one workspace.

name: sightglass_find_top_angles
title: Find angles across brands
